subject: Prod surge: telemetry custody & retention checks
messages:
From: Alice Park <alice.park@greenline.com>
To: soojin.lee@redwood.com
Cc: ops@greenline.com
Date: Fri, 09 Oct 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Unusual latency + 500 spike — immediate question on logs/chain-of-custody

Hi Soojin,

We just observed a significant latency increase and a burst of 500 errors across our production integration between 08:50-09:05 UTC (roughly 15 minutes ago). This caused timeouts for several core flows; we're still triaging on our side.

Two immediate asks:
- Can Redwood preserve raw runtime traces/logs for the window 2027-10-09T08:45:00Z to 2027-10-09T09:10:00Z and confirm retention policy for those artifacts?
- We may need an auditable chain-of-custody for anything you provide (who accessed, export hashes, transfer method). Please confirm what you can supply and the expected delivery timeline.

Greenline security is asking for an encrypted transfer or S3 presigned link with limited TTL. Also advise on whether any PII/tokens are present in the raw traces and your redaction capabilities.

We may escalate to our CTO if we don't get confirmation within 2 hours. Attaching a screenshot of our error dashboard.

Thanks,
Alice Park
Ops Lead, Greenline Inc
[Attachment: greenline_sla_breach_screenshot.png]

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Alice Park <alice.park@greenline.com>
Cc: jordan.blake@redwood.com, vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com, aditya.rao@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 09 Oct 2027 15:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Unusual latency + 500 spike — immediate question on logs/chain-of-custody

Alice — thanks for the heads up and the screenshot. We see the same spike on our side in the candidate routing tier and are treating this as a P1.

Immediate actions we're taking (summary):
1) Preservation: we have initiated a legal/forensics hold on the serving nodes that handled requests during 2027-10-09T08:40:00Z — 2027-10-09T09:20:00Z. Raw traces and kernel-level telemetry will be preserved for 90 days in immutable storage pending your request.
2) Evidence package: we will collect request/response traces, scheduler logs, model variant routing decisions, and aggregated token metrics for the window.
3) Chain-of-custody: Security will compute SHA256 hashes for exported files and log the export event. We can provide a signed manifest and an access audit showing which RedWood personnel accessed the package.
4) Transfer: we can push a GPG-encrypted bundle to a dedicated S3 bucket (presigned, TTL 48 hours) or use a one-time secure transfer. Tell us your preference.

What we need from you to expedite: exact request_ids or example request timestamps (UTC) and any user IDs you want redacted. If you want us to produce a redacted sample, indicate whether token values should be replaced with stable placeholders or fully removed.

Estimate: initial evidence bundle ready within 72 hours; sample redacted export within 24 hours if you confirm redaction policy. If this becomes legal-led, timeline may adjust.

CC'ing Jordan (ops lead) and Vanessa (account lead) to coordinate the export and delivery. Attaching our internal preservation checklist for visibility.

— Soojin Lee
Sr. Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: preservation_checklist.pdf]

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Alice Park <alice.park@greenline.com>
Cc: jordan.blake@redwood.com, vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com, aditya.rao@redwood.com, soojin.lee@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 09 Oct 2027 20:02:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Unusual latency + 500 spike — legal hold & evidence delivery plan

Alice — I'm Laura Bennett from Redwood Legal. I'm stepping in to put formal notice on the preservation and to outline controls for evidence delivery.

Summary of commitments: 
- Legal hold: Redwood has invoked an internal legal hold covering all artifacts related to Greenline production traffic for 2027-10-09T08:40:00Z — 2027-10-09T09:20:00Z. The hold is internal and will prevent routine deletions for 90 days or until you instruct release.
- Evidence package: We will provide a signed manifest (SHA256 hashes) and an access log showing identities and timestamps for anyone who accesses the package. Expected baseline deliverable: within 72 hours.
- Redaction: Per your request, logs will have OAuth tokens and user emails replaced with stable placeholders. We will not alter timestamp precision.
- Transfer: We will stage the encrypted bundle on our secure S3 (AES-256). We'll send a presigned URL with 48-hour TTL; if you prefer a different transfer, we can use an alternate secure channel.

Required actions from Greenline to release: sign the attached limited-evidence-release form to permit cross-customer telemetry to be included in the package (we minimize exposure; only records that match the provided request IDs and time window will be included). There's a DocuSign link in this email for acceptance. If Legal prefers, we can route the export directly to your security team's S3.

We're adding this incident to our exec queue. CC'ing Jordan for operational details and Vanessa for account visibility. Aditya will coordinate billing/contractual implications if this triggers SLA credits.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: legal_hold_notice.pdf]
